operation_sequence.start: FWP_HP_RUN 0->1; check permissives; leave VCB-A01 closed; energize motor; build physical RPM; assert SPEED_PROVEN and RUNNING
operation_sequence.normal_stop: FWP_HP_RUN 1->0; remove run enable; keep VCB-A01 closed; coast RPM to the absolute zero-speed gate; return READY
operation_sequence.trip: latch trip; remove run enable; issue VCB-A01 trip; change closed feedback to open after breaker delay; coast RPM instead of forcing zero
operation_sequence.reset: require trip cause clear, run request off, speed <= zero-speed gate and breaker open; clear latch only; do not reclose and do not restart
operation_sequence.reclose: separate VCB-A01 close command after reset; START cannot reclose the breaker

motor_surrogate: RPM acceleration and coast-down until an electrical motor model is connected

co_simulation_boundary.thermo_feedback: TSP.DRUM.HP.FW_FLOW in kg/s; drum level in m; drum pressure in Pa
co_simulation_boundary.electrical_feedback_replacement: Replace virtual feeder_cb_closed_fb and run_fb with solved ECMS electrical-twin feedback
co_simulation_boundary.time_order: read feedback at synchronization point; execute logic; apply command for next step; solve electrical and process states; record native timestamps

guardrail: 1400 rpm is taken directly from the ThermoSysPro model. Breaker timing and motor time constants are virtual-model parameters until approved C&E, breaker data and motor/load/inertia data are supplied.
